City of Charlottetown Report No: PH-2026-05-05

 Committee Report Date: May 5, 2026
Directed to Council through the following Attachments:
Committee: Planning and Heritage Committee . Pedestrian Mall Bylaw
Reporting Department: DRAFT - Pedestrian Mall Agreement
Planning and Heritage Department
Other Associated Departments:
None
Prepared by:
Brad Vince, Planner II & Heritage Officer
Report Title:
Amendment to the Pedestrian Mall Bylaw Agreement Operating Hours
Report Purpose:
To request that the Planning and Heritage Committee consider extending the closing time of the
Victoria Row Pedestrian Mall operations to 1:00 AM on a permanent basis.
Staff Recommendation:
That the Planning and Heritage Committee recommends that Council approve the permanent
extension of the Pedestrian Mall closing time to 1:00 a.m.
Report Details:

Background

The Victoria Row Merchants Association requested a change to the operating hours in the Pedestrian
Mall Agreement with the City of Charlottetown. They asked to extend patio hours during the season by
one hour, from 8:00 a.m.-12:00 a.m. to 8:00 a.m.-1:00 a.m.

The request was made to help businesses manage the impacts of nearby construction and closures

document_structure_standards.description: The agenda appears first in the standalone agenda PDF and is repeated as the first package document. Treat these pages as one logical agenda source.
Most actionable items begin with a City resolution or committee/staff report template, followed by minutes, reports, maps, bylaws, tables, or application attachments.
document_structure_standards.review_action: When a future package does not start an item with a recognizable template page, create a review flag instead of forcing extraction into a known template type.

document_structure_standards.description: Document boundaries are detected from visible title-page changes, page x of y markers, recurring committee report covers, resolution cover pages, and table/report formatting shifts.

page_reproduction_options.label: Rendered page images
page_reproduction_options.delivery: Pre-render each PDF page to PNG or WebP and serve by source document plus page number.
page_reproduction_options.accuracy: High visual fidelity at chosen DPI; selectable text requires a separate OCR/text overlay.
page_reproduction_options.fit: Best first implementation for top-level agenda view and filtered item pages without serving PDF.

page_reproduction_options.label: SVG page renderings
page_reproduction_options.delivery: Convert each PDF page to SVG and serve the SVG assets directly.
page_reproduction_options.accuracy: Can preserve vector geometry and text, but fonts and browser rendering may vary.
page_reproduction_options.fit: Useful where zoom fidelity matters and the source PDFs convert cleanly.

page_reproduction_options.label: Image plus positioned text layer
page_reproduction_options.delivery: Render each page image and add a generated HTML text layer from PDF coordinates.
page_reproduction_options.accuracy: Strong visual fidelity with searchable/copyable text, but coordinate extraction needs QA.
page_reproduction_options.fit: Best long-term web viewer path if source-page interaction matters.

review_flags.message: Package document boundaries are deterministic for this May 12 package but were seeded from observed page headings and page-number patterns; future packages require mismatch flags before reuse.
